budget.budget_note: Defaults sit far below the $5 free pre-registration credit: at most ~$1/day of triage calls even if the agent loops.

model_note: Cheapest model in the SERV catalog (docs.openserv.ai/serv-reasoning/models, checked 2026-11-09): $0.130 input / $0.650 output per 1M tokens. Official Day One guidance: start from the smallest model that can do the job.
pricing_note: Estimates treat 1 SERV credit as approx. 1 USD (credits are sold USD-denominated; the participant grant is $5). Estimates are budgeting aids for the spending policy, not billing records.
